description.value: Zythos Greek Mediterranean Grill is a full-service Greek restaurant in Langley's Port Kells neighbourhood, seating up to 85 people with a private party room for groups of up to 26. The menu centres on traditional Greek fare including souvlaki, roast lamb, spanakopita, and house salads. Touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley will find a substantial sit-down meal option as well as pickup and delivery through major platforms.
